header.running_head: The Marriages of Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA)

blocks.text: the man obliged, "it will be a great honour and pleasure." "I do not wish to marry her to myself (but to someone else)," Rasulullaah ﷺ pointed out. "Then for whom?" the Ansaari asked. "For Julaybeeb," Rasulullaah ﷺ replied. The Ansaars said, "I shall consult with her mother."

He then asked (his wife), "Rasulullaah ﷺ has proposed for your daughter." "Of course," she agreed, "it will be a great pleasure." "However," the Ansaari explained, "he is not proposing for himself, but on behalf of Julaybeeb." The lady burst out, "To Julaybeeb! Never! To Julaybeeb! Never! I swear by life that we shall never marry him (to our daughter)!" As the Ansaari was about to get up to inform Rasulullaah ﷺ about what the mother said when the daughter asked, "Who was it that brought to you a proposal for me?" When the mother informed her (that it was Rasulullaah ﷺ who brought the proposal), the girl asked, "Are you then rejecting the command of Rasulullaah ﷺ? Hand me over in marriage to him for he shall never destroy me (since the marriage is with Rasulullaah ﷺ's approval)."

Her father then went to Rasulullaah ﷺ and reported the incident to him, saying, "My daughter places her affairs in your hands. You may marry her to whomever you please." Rasulullaah ﷺ then proceeded to get her married to Hadhrat Julaybeeb (RA).

It then occurred that Rasulullaah ﷺ once went out to a battle. After Allaah had given Rasulullaah ﷺ a large booty, he asked, "Is someone missing?" When the Sahabah (RA) said that they found no one missing, Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "But I notice that Julaybeeb is missing. Look for him." When the Sahabah (RA) went out in search of him, they found him beside the bodies of seven men of the enemy whom he had killed before the enemy managed to kill him. They then reported back saying, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! He is there beside the bodies of seven men of the enemy whom he had killed before the enemy managed to kill him." Rasulullaah ﷺ went to the body of Hadhrat Julaybeeb (RA) and said, "He killed seven before they managed to kill him. He is from me and I from him." Rasulullaah ﷺ repeated this two or three times and then took him in his arms. A grave was then dug for him and there was no bier besides the arms of Rasulullaah ﷺ. Rasulullaah ﷺ himself lay the body in the grave. The Hadith does not state whether the body was bathed or not.

When Hadhrat Thaabit noted that there was no widow from the Ansaar who was more charitable than the widow of Hadhrat Julaybeeb (RA), Hadhrat Is'haaq bin Abdullaah bin Abu Talha said to him, "Do you know what du'aa Rasulullaah ﷺ made for her? He said, 'O Allaah! Pour down good on her in abundance and never give her a life of hardship.' It is for this reason that there was never a widow amongst the Ansaar more charitable than her." [^1]
